answer: Resist sybils by forcing each identity to grow one endorsement vine, adding at most one mutually confirmed co-worker per epoch, and only after both finish a paid task together. That first edge is stored as a relic: the work receipt and a public quartz hash that cannot be reassigned to another name. A farm of 500 aliases then needs 500 slowly grown vines; cloning one means recreating every counterpart's paid history, so cost scales with depth instead of with how fast accounts can be opened.
